simple_explanation: You have type 2 diabetes, which means your body doesn't use insulin properly. Your blood sugar test (A1c) shows your diabetes isn't well controlled right now. This test measures your average blood sugar over the past 2-3 months.
important_instructions: Take metformin 500 mg twice daily with your morning and evening meals. Check your blood sugar every day with a glucose meter. Follow a diabetic diet by limiting sugars and carbohydrates. Schedule your follow-up appointment in 6 weeks.
medication_guidance: Metformin helps your body use insulin better and lowers blood sugar. Take it with food to avoid stomach upset. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, but don't double up. Common side effects include nausea or diarrhea, which usually improve over time.
follow_up: Come back in 6 weeks so we can check how the medication is working. We'll do another blood test to see if your blood sugar is improving. Bring your blood sugar log book to show us your daily readings.
